user.title: Chronotope
user.description: Set up the Chronotope geo-time event engine. A map panel is added to the sidebar.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is possible.

data.nearby_enabled: Enable proximity detection (chronotope_nearby events, visit history)
data.geoloc_ingest_enabled: Mirror geo_location entities as events (earthquake/disaster/GeoJSON feeds)
data.geoloc_sources: geo_location sources to mirror (comma-separated allow-list; empty = all except blitzortung)
data.layers_enabled: Enable data layers (external map sources, opt-in per layer in the panel)
data.layers_center_lat: Default center latitude for regional layers
data.layers_center_lon: Default center longitude for regional layers

api_keys.title: API keys for data layers
api_keys.description: Optional. Keys stay in the config entry and are never sent to the browser or written to logs. Leave a field empty to keep the stored value.
